decisions.reason: The Page 24 crop adjustment changes tree visibility but does not change which photos must be included or where required photos are placed.
The source concerns a Page 24 photo crop and does not alter the background treatment of the specified key pages.
A localized photo-crop adjustment does not change the document-wide layout, coverage, or page-layout strategy.
The source contains no change to typefaces, font sizes, or unresolved bold formatting.
Showing more of a tree in one photograph does not change the proposal's brand identity, colors, or logo source.
The Page 24 image-crop request does not add, remove, or resolve any required narrative section content.
The photo adjustment does not reorder or otherwise change the fixed RFQ section sequence.
The source does not change Canva ownership, editing access, asset restrictions, or source-deliverable requirements.
The Page 24 photograph is unrelated to the one-page proposal letter and signature-insertion behavior.
The request to reveal more of the tree does not necessarily change the document's page-count target or spacing-compaction rule.
A task-local crop revision to the current proposal does not change the deferred reusable-template requirements.
The source concerns only a photograph and does not alter table inclusion, replacement, or source details.
